title: FacisParticipantCredential
description: Organisational credential of a FAP participant. Issued by the OCM W-Stack issuer via OID4VCI to the participant's connector; presented in DSP contract negotiations, inbound and outbound. Carries no personal data. Draft 0.2.

id.description: The organisation DID (did:web, keys in the TSA crypto provider). Also the DSP participantId and the org_did that the policy agent and Keycloak use.

legalName.description: Registered legal name of the organisation.

participantRoles.description: Dataspace-level roles of the organisation. Distinct from the person/service roles of FapIotAiRoleCredential.

trustFramework.description: Trust framework the issuer attests under.

dspEndpoint.description: Optional: the participant's DSP protocol endpoint, so a counterparty can bind the credential to the connector it talks to.
